sentences.text: 4. He has also taken this Court to paragraph 7 to show that earlier a land on which his hut was present, a compensation amount of Rs. 88,385/- was awarded to him and paid in the year, 2021 and thereafter the hut was removed.
The land was also handed over to the NH Authority.

It is his further submission that on 28.02.2022, without prior notice and resorting to the proceeding under the Act,
his residential house was demolished and as such, appropriate action be taken against the respondent- authorities and he is entitiled to a suitable compensation.

5. A reply has been filed on behalf of the respondents and as per the supplementary counter affidavit filed on behalf of Patna High Court CWJC No.8691 of 2022(7) dt.12-02-2024 respondent nos. 2 to 4 and 8, in paragraph 8, they have vitually accepted the removal of encroachment stating therein that the petitioner illegally raised construction over the land which was removed and report submitted vide letter no. 307 dated 30.04.2022 by the Sub-Divisional Officer, Jaynagar.

sentences.text: Learned State Counsel submits that this is the same land on which the hut was present and he was compensated but later, a structure was erected which was removed.

7. Upon query, learned counsel for the petitioner is unable to clarify whether the submission of the learned State Counsel that it is the same land on which compensation was made to him or a different land as stated in paragraph 7 of the petition.
No details of the land has been given so that the same can be ascertained by the Court.
8. This Court has thus taken note of the fact that the details of the land on which he was compensated, is missing.
In that circumstance, the learned counsel for the petitioner is required to furnish the details of the land on which the hut was present and for which he received the compensation amount.

9. However, it is clear that there was certain structure on the land (details of which has been incorporated in para 8 of the petition) which as per the supplementary counter affidavit of Patna High Court CWJC No.8691 of 2022(7) dt.12-02-2024 the respondents, it was demolished and it is not the case of the State respondent that the same was done in accordance with law.
10.

This Court is convinced that the State authorities are in the habit of flouting the rules/regulations/ guidelines/specific act in the matter and in a high handedness act, on their will,
goes and demolishes any encroached strucuture of a citizen.

11. As learned counsel for the petitioner has not furnished the details of the land on which the compensation was granted, the matter is adjourned for two weeks enabling him to bring on record the details.

12. List on 26.02.2024.
(Rajiv Roy, J) kiran/-
